note.fact: For smooth periodic paths on a compact time interval, the spatial Fourier expansions, their time derivatives used in S003, and the products of these series can be differentiated and integrated termwise. On each smooth piece the fundamental theorem of calculus gives the endpoint difference of J; for continuous piecewise smooth paths the one-sided J endpoint values coincide.

grounds.reason: The normal-form argument explicitly restricts to smooth mean-zero paths and then continuous piecewise smooth paths on [a,b].
The time-dependent S multiplier is exp(itk^3), whose time derivative introduces only a polynomial factor in k.
J consists of these multipliers, inverse derivatives, projection and multiplication.

note.justification: Repeated spatial integration by parts bounds Fourier coefficients, including those of the required time derivatives, by arbitrarily high inverse powers of the frequency, uniformly on each compact smooth time piece. Choosing the decay exponent above all polynomial factors gives absolutely and uniformly convergent double series and differentiated series. Uniform convergence justifies their integrals and derivatives. Applying the fundamental theorem to J yields S003's integral identity. Its polynomial formula is continuous in smooth-path values, so adjacent endpoint terms cancel. The zero summands r=0 or s=0 are excluded by Dinv's zero convention; mean-zero inputs ensure that omitting them also loses no B term.

arguments.statement: ∀ (s : ℝ) (f : Coeff) (k : ℤ), MemH s f → weight s k * ‖f k‖^2 ≤ (hn s f)^2
arguments.proof:
intro s f k hf
have hw : ∀ j : ℤ, 0 ≤ weight s j * ‖f j‖ ^ 2 := by
  intro j
  exact mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _)
have hs : 0 ≤ ∑' j, weight s j * ‖f j‖ ^ 2 := tsum_nonneg hw
rw [hn, Real.sq_sqrt hs]
exact Summable.le_tsum hf k (fun j _ => hw j)

arguments.statement: ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.mul f g = KdVPlan.mul g f
arguments.proof:
intro f g
funext k
unfold KdVPlan.mul
have e : (fun j : ℤ => k-j) ∘ (fun j : ℤ => k-j) = id := by funext j; dsimp; omega
let E : ℤ ≃ ℤ := ⟨(fun j => k-j), (fun j => k-j), (fun j => by omega), (fun j => by omega)⟩
convert E.tsum_eq (fun j => g j * f (k-j)) using 1
· apply tsum_congr
  intro j
  dsimp [E]
  congr 1 <;> try omega
  exact mul_comm _ _

1229:     refine (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo).mono fun x hx => ?_
1230:     exact (hderiv x hx).derivWithin (uniqueDiffWithinAt_Ioi _)

1243:   have A : ∫⁻ x : ℝ in Ioo a b, f x = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in Ioo a b, F x) :=
1244:     lintegral_coe_eq_integral _ intF
1245:   rw [A] at hf
1246:   have B : (∫ x : ℝ in Ioo a b, F x) ≤ g b - g a := by
1247:     rw [← integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]

arguments.statement: Summable (fun j : ℤ => (1 : ℝ) / (1+(j : ℝ)^2))
arguments.proof:
have h : Summable (fun j : ℤ => if j = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 1/(j : ℝ)^2) := by
  have hs : Summable (fun j : ℤ => (1 : ℝ)/(j : ℝ)^2) := Real.summable_one_div_int_pow.mpr (by norm_num : 1 < 2)
  exact hs.congr_cofinite (by filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_cofinite_ne (0 : ℤ)] with j hj; simp [hj])
apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => by positivity) _ h
intro j
split_ifs with hj
· subst j; norm_num
· exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith [sq_nonneg (j : ℝ)])

151: ### Multiplying two infinite sums
152: 
153: In this section, we prove various results about `(∑' x : ι, f x) * (∑' y : κ, g y)`. Note that we
154: always assume that the family `fun x : ι × κ ↦ f x.1 * g x.2` is summable, since there is no way to
155: deduce this from the summabilities of `f` and `g` in general, but if you are working in a normed
156: space, you may want to use the analogous lemmas in `Analysis.Normed.Module.Basic`
157: (e.g `tsum_mul_tsum_of_summable_norm`).
158: 
159: We first establish results about arbitrary index types, `ι` and `κ`, and then we specialize to
160: `ι = κ = ℕ` to prove the Cauchy product formula (see `tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_antidiagonal`).
161: 
162: #### Arbitrary index types
163: -/
164:

166: section tsum_mul_tsum

168: variable [TopologicalSpace α] [T3Space α] [NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring α] [IsTopologicalSemiring α]
169:   {f : ι → α} {g : κ → α} {s t u : α}
170: 
171: theorem HasSum.mul_eq (hf : HasSum f s) (hg : HasSum g t)
172:     (hfg : HasSum (fun x : ι × κ ↦ f x.1 * g x.2) u) : s * t = u :=
173:   have key₁ : HasSum (fun i ↦ f i * t) (s * t) := hf.mul_right t
174:   have this : ∀ i : ι, HasSum (fun c : κ ↦ f i * g c) (f i * t) := fun i ↦ hg.mul_left (f i)
175:   have key₂ : HasSum (fun i ↦ f i * t) u := HasSum.prod_fiberwise hfg this
176:   key₁.unique key₂
177: 
178: theorem HasSum.mul (hf : HasSum f s) (hg : HasSum g t)
179:     (hfg : Summable fun x : ι × κ ↦ f x.1 * g x.2) :
180:     HasSum (fun x : ι × κ ↦ f x.1 * g x.2) (s * t) :=
181:   let ⟨_u, hu⟩ := hfg
182:   (hf.mul_eq hg hu).symm ▸ hu
183: 
184: /-- Product of two infinite sums indexed by arbitrary types.

arguments.statement: ∀ (t : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff) (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → KdVPlan.J t f g k = ∑' j : ℤ, (KdVPlan.phase (3*(k : ℝ)*(j : ℝ)*((k-j : ℤ) : ℝ)) t / ((Complex.I * (j : ℂ)) * (Complex.I * ((k-j : ℤ) : ℂ)))) * f j * g (k-j)
arguments.proof:
intro t f g k hk
simp only [KdVPlan.J, KdVPlan.S, KdVPlan.P, if_neg hk, KdVPlan.mul]
rw [← tsum_mul_left]
apply tsum_congr
intro j
rw [← yui_aux_0009 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 t k j]
by_cases hj : j = 0
· simp [KdVPlan.invD, hj]
by_cases hs : k-j = 0
· simp [KdVPlan.invD, hs]
simp only [KdVPlan.invD, if_neg hj, if_neg hs, mul_inv_rev, div_eq_mul_inv]
ring

arguments.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f g df dg : KdVPlan.Path) (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → (∀ u ∈ ({f,g,df,dg} : Set KdVPlan.Path), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ j : ℤ, ‖u t j‖ ≤ C / (1+(j : ℝ)^2)) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ j : ℤ, HasDerivAt (fun r => f r j) (df t j) t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun r => g r j) (dg t j) t) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f t) ∧ KdVPlan.ZeroMean (g t)) → ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, ∀ k : ℤ, HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.J r (f r) (g r) k) (3 * KdVPlan.B t (f t) (g t) k + KdVPlan.J t (df t) (g t) k + KdVPlan.J t (f t) (dg t) k) t

intro a b f g df dg C hC hbd hd hz t ht k
by_cases hk : k = 0
· subst k
  simpa [KdVPlan.J, KdVPlan.B, KdVPlan.S, KdVPlan.P, KdVPlan.dx] using (hasDerivAt_const t (0 : ℂ))
have hplain : ∀ u ∈ ({f,g,df,dg} : Set KdVPlan.Path), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ j : ℤ, ‖u t j‖ ≤ C := by
  intro u hu r hr j

by_cases hk : k = 0

  simpa [KdVPlan.J, KdVPlan.B, KdVPlan.S, KdVPlan.P, KdVPlan.dx] using (hasDerivAt_const t (0 : ℂ))

  calc
    _ ≤ (3 : ℝ)*‖(Complex.I * (k : ℂ)) * KdVPlan.phase (3*(k : ℝ)*(j : ℝ)*((k-j : ℤ) : ℝ)) t * f t j * g t (k-j)‖ + ‖(KdVPlan.phase (3*(k : ℝ)*(j : ℝ)*((k-j : ℤ) : ℝ)) t / ((Complex.I * (j : ℂ)) * (Complex.I * ((k-j : ℤ) : ℂ)))) * df t j * g t (k-j)‖ + ‖(KdVPlan.phase (3*(k : ℝ)*(j : ℝ)*((k-j : ℤ) : ℝ)) t / ((Complex.I * (j : ℂ)) * (Complex.I * ((k-j : ℤ) : ℂ)))) * f t j * dg t (k-j)‖ := by

183: /-!
184: ## Basic properties of interval integrability
185: - interval integrability is symmetric, reflexive, transitive
186: - monotonicity and strong measurability of the interval integral
187: - if `f` is interval integrable, so are its absolute value and norm
188: - arithmetic properties
189: -/
190: namespace IntervalIntegrable
191: 
192: section
193: 
194: variable {f : ℝ → ε} {a b c d : ℝ} {μ ν : Measure ℝ}
195: 
196: @[symm]
197: nonrec theorem symm (h : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b) : IntervalIntegrable f μ b a :=
198:   h.symm
199: 
200: theorem symm_iff : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b ↔ IntervalIntegrable f μ b a := ⟨.symm, .symm⟩
201: 
202: @[refl, simp]
203: theorem refl : IntervalIntegrable f μ a a := by constructor <;> simp
204: 
205: variable [PseudoMetrizableSpace ε]
206: 
207: @[trans]
208: theorem trans {a b c : ℝ} (hab : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b) (hbc : IntervalIntegrable f μ b c) :
209:     IntervalIntegrable f μ a c :=
210:   ⟨(hab.1.union hbc.1).mono_set Ioc_subset_Ioc_union_Ioc,
211:     (hbc.2.union hab.2).mono_set Ioc_subset_Ioc_union_Ioc⟩
212: 
213: theorem trans_iff (h : b ∈ [[a, c]]) :
214:     IntervalIntegrable f μ a c ↔ IntervalIntegrable f μ a b ∧ IntervalIntegrable f μ b c := by
215:   simp only [intervalIntegrable_iff, ← integrableOn_union, uIoc_union_uIoc h]
216: 
217: theorem trans_iterate_Ico {a : ℕ → ℝ} {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n)
218:     (hint : ∀ k ∈ Ico m n, IntervalIntegrable f μ (a k) (a <| k + 1)) :
219:     IntervalIntegrable f μ (a m) (a n) := by
220:   revert hint
221:   refine Nat.le_induction ?_ ?_ n hmn
222:   · simp
223:   · intro p hp IH h
224:     exact (IH fun k hk => h k (Ico_subset_Ico_right p.le_succ hk)).trans (h p (by simp [hp]))
225: 
226: theorem trans_iterate {a : ℕ → ℝ} {n : ℕ}
227:     (hint : ∀ k < n, IntervalIntegrable f μ (a k) (a <| k + 1)) :
228:     IntervalIntegrable f μ (a 0) (a n) :=
229:   trans_iterate_Ico bot_le fun k hk => hint k hk.2
230: 
231: theorem neg {f : ℝ → E} (h : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b) : IntervalIntegrable (-f) μ a b :=
232:   ⟨h.1.neg, h.2.neg⟩
233: 
234: omit [PseudoMetrizableSpace ε] in
235: theorem enorm (h : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b) : IntervalIntegrable (‖f ·‖ₑ) μ a b :=
236:   ⟨h.1.enorm, h.2.enorm⟩
237: 
238: theorem norm {f : ℝ → E} (h : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b) : IntervalIntegrable (‖f ·‖) μ a b :=
239:   ⟨h.1.norm, h.2.norm⟩

arguments.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.SmoothOn a b f → KdVPlan.SmoothOn a b g → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f t) ∧ KdVPlan.ZeroMean (g t)) → ∀ k : ℤ, IntervalIntegrable (fun t => KdVPlan.B t (f t) (g t) k) MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun t => KdVPlan.J t (KdVPlan.dt f t) (g t) k + KdVPlan.J t (f t) (KdVPlan.dt g t) k) MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧ KdVPlan.J b (f b) (g b) k-KdVPlan.J a (f a) (g a) k = 3*(∫ t in a..b, KdVPlan.B t (f t) (g t) k)+(∫ t in a..b, KdVPlan.J t (KdVPlan.dt f t) (g t) k+KdVPlan.J t (f t) (KdVPlan.dt g t) k)
arguments.proof:
intro a b f g hab hf hg hz k
rcases yui_aux_0021 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b f hf with ⟨df, A, hA, hfc, hdfc, hfb, hfd⟩
rcases yui_aux_0021 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b g hg with ⟨dg, D, hD, hgc, hdgc, hgb, hgd⟩
let C := A+D
have hC : 0 ≤ C := add_nonneg hA hD
have HC : ∀ u ∈ ({f,g,df,dg} : Set KdVPlan.Path), ∀ k : ℤ, ContinuousOn (fun t => u t k) (Set.Icc a b) := by
  intro u hu
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hu
  rcases hu with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact hfc
  · exact hgc
  · exact hdfc
  · exact hdgc
have HB : ∀ u ∈ ({f,g,df,dg} : Set KdVPlan.Path), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ j : ℤ, ‖u t j‖ ≤ C / (1+(j : ℝ)^2) := by
  intro u hu t ht j
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hu
  rcases hu with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact (hfb t ht j).1.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith) (by positivity))
  · exact (hgb t ht j).1.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith) (by positivity))
  · exact (hfb t ht j).2.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith) (by positivity))
  · exact (hgb t ht j).2.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith) (by positivity))
have H (u : KdVPlan.Path) (hu : u ∈ ({f,g,df,dg} : Set KdVPlan.Path)) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (hv : v ∈ ({f,g,df,dg} : Set KdVPlan.Path)) :=
  yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b u v C C hC hC (HC u hu) (HC v hv) (HB u hu) (fun t ht j => (HB v hv t ht j).trans (div_le_self hC (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (j : ℝ)]))) k
have ib := (H f (by simp) g (by simp)).1.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab
have idf := (H df (by simp) g (by simp)).2.1.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab
have idg := (H f (by simp) dg (by simp)).2.1.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc hab
have heq : Set.EqOn (fun t => KdVPlan.J t (df t) (g t) k+KdVPlan.J t (f t) (dg t) k) (fun t => KdVPlan.J t (KdVPlan.dt f t) (g t) k+KdVPlan.J t (f t) (KdVPlan.dt g t) k) (Set.Ioo a b) := by
  intro t ht
  have hfe : df t = KdVPlan.dt f t := funext (fun j => (hfd t ht j).2)
  have hge : dg t = KdVPlan.dt g t := funext (fun j => (hgd t ht j).2)
  rw [hfe, hge]
have idt := (idf.add idg).congr_uIoo (by simpa only [Set.uIoo_of_le hab] using heq)
refine ⟨ib, idt, ?_⟩
have hd := yui_aux_0020 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b f g df dg C hC HB (fun t ht j => ⟨(hfd t ht j).1, (hgd t ht j).1⟩) hz
have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hab (H f (by simp) g (by simp)).2.1 (fun t ht => hd t ht k) (((ib.const_mul 3).add idf).add idg)
rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((ib.const_mul 3).add idf) idg, intervalIntegral.integral_add (ib.const_mul 3) idf, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hftc
have ie := intervalIntegral.integral_congr_Ioo_of_le hab heq
rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add idf idg] at ie
linear_combination -hftc + ie

arguments.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.SmoothOn a b f → KdVPlan.SmoothOn a b g → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f t) ∧ KdVPlan.ZeroMean (g t)) → ∀ k : ℤ, IntervalIntegrable (fun t => KdVPlan.B t (f t) (g t) k) MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧ IntervalIntegrable (fun t => KdVPlan.J t (KdVPlan.dt f t) (g t) k + KdVPlan.J t (f t) (KdVPlan.dt g t) k) MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧ KdVPlan.J b (f b) (g b) k-KdVPlan.J a (f a) (g a) k = 3*(∫ t in a..b, KdVPlan.B t (f t) (g t) k)+(∫ t in a..b, KdVPlan.J t (KdVPlan.dt f t) (g t) k+KdVPlan.J t (f t) (KdVPlan.dt g t) k)
arguments.proof:
intro a b f g hab hf hg hz k
rcases yui_aux_0021 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b f hf with ⟨df, A, hA, hfc, hdfc, hfb, hfd⟩
rcases yui_aux_0021 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b g hg with ⟨dg, D, hD, hgc, hdgc, hgb, hgd⟩
let C := A+D
have hC : 0 ≤ C := add_nonneg hA hD
have HC : ∀ u ∈ ({f,g,df,dg} : Set KdVPlan.Path), ∀ k : ℤ, ContinuousOn (fun t => u t k) (Set.Icc a b) := by
  intro u hu
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hu
  rcases hu with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact hfc
  · exact hgc
  · exact hdfc
  · exact hdgc
have HB : ∀ u ∈ ({f,g,df,dg} : Set KdVPlan.Path), ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ j : ℤ, ‖u t j‖ ≤ C / (1+(j : ℝ)^2) := by
  intro u hu t ht j
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hu
  rcases hu with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact (hfb t ht j).1.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith) (by positivity))
  · exact (hgb t ht j).1.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith) (by positivity))
  · exact (hfb t ht j).2.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith) (by positivity))
  · exact (hgb t ht j).2.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith) (by positivity))
have H (u : KdVPlan.Path) (hu : u ∈ ({f,g,df,dg} : Set KdVPlan.Path)) (v : KdVPlan.Path) (hv : v ∈ ({f,g,df,dg} : Set KdVPlan.Path)) :=
  yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b u v C C hC hC (HC u hu) (HC v hv) (HB u hu) (fun t ht j => (HB v hv t ht j).trans (div_le_self hC (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (j : ℝ)]))) k
have ib := (H f (by simp) g (by simp)).1.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hab
have idf := (H df (by simp) g (by simp)).2.1.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hab
have idg := (H f (by simp) dg (by simp)).2.1.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hab
have heq : Set.EqOn (fun t => KdVPlan.J t (df t) (g t) k+KdVPlan.J t (f t) (dg t) k) (fun t => KdVPlan.J t (KdVPlan.dt f t) (g t) k+KdVPlan.J t (f t) (KdVPlan.dt g t) k) (Set.Ioo a b) := by
  intro t ht
  have hfe : df t = KdVPlan.dt f t := funext (fun j => (hfd t ht j).2)
  have hge : dg t = KdVPlan.dt g t := funext (fun j => (hgd t ht j).2)
  dsimp only
  rw [hfe, hge]
have idt := (idf.add idg).congr_uIoo (by simpa only [Set.uIoo_of_le hab] using heq)
refine ⟨ib, idt, ?_⟩
have hd := yui_aux_0020 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b f g df dg C hC HB (fun t ht j => ⟨(hfd t ht j).1, (hgd t ht j).1⟩) hz
have hftc := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hab (H f (by simp) g (by simp)).2.1 (fun t ht => hd t ht k) (((ib.const_mul 3).add idf).add idg)
rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add ((ib.const_mul 3).add idf) idg, intervalIntegral.integral_add (ib.const_mul 3) idf, intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at hftc
have ie := intervalIntegral.integral_congr_Ioo_of_le hab heq
rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add idf idg] at ie
linear_combination -hftc + ie

arguments.statement: ∀ (p : Finset ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (U V H : ℝ → ℂ), a ≤ b → (∀ l r : ℝ, a ≤ l → l < r → r ≤ b → (∀ x ∈ p, x ∉ Set.Ioo l r) → IntervalIntegrable U MeasureTheory.volume l r ∧ IntervalIntegrable V MeasureTheory.volume l r ∧ H r-H l = 3*(∫ t in l..r, U t)+(∫ t in l..r, V t)) → IntervalIntegrable U MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧ IntervalIntegrable V MeasureTheory.volume a b ∧ H b-H a = 3*(∫ t in a..b, U t)+(∫ t in a..b, V t)

classical
intro p
induction p using Finset.induction_on with
| empty =>
  intro a b U V H hab hs
  by_cases he : a = b
  · subst b; simp
  · exact hs a b le_rfl (lt_of_le_of_ne hab he) le_rfl (by simp)
| @insert x p hxp ih =>
  intro a b U V H hab hs

helper.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Path), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.Piecewise a b f → KdVPlan.Piecewise a b g → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f t)) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc a b, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (g t)) → KdVPlan.timeInt a b (fun t => KdVPlan.B t (f t) (g t)) = KdVPlan.scale (1/3) (KdVPlan.J b (f b) (g b)-KdVPlan.J a (f a) (g a)) - KdVPlan.scale (1/3) (KdVPlan.timeInt a b (fun t => KdVPlan.J t (KdVPlan.dt f t) (g t)+KdVPlan.J t (f t) (KdVPlan.dt g t)))
helper.scope: Checked same-node theorem; available in later checks and the final body.

arguments.statement: (∀ (t : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.S (-t) f) = f) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.S t f) = KdVPlan.S t (KdVPlan.invD f)) ∧ (∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.invD (KdVPlan.dx f) = KdVPlan.P f)
arguments.proof:
constructor
· intro t f
  funext k
  simp only [KdVPlan.S, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
  have he : Complex.I * (t*(k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ) + Complex.I * ((-t)*(k : ℝ)^3 : ℝ) = 0 := by push_cast; ring
  rw [he, Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]
constructor
· intro t f
  funext k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.S, hk]
  · simp only [KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.S, if_neg hk]
    ring
· intro f
  funext k
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · simp [KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.P, hk]
  · simp only [KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.dx, KdVPlan.P, if_neg hk]
    rw [inv_mul_cancel_left₀]
    exact mul_ne_zero Complex.I_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hk)

arguments.statement: ∀ (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff) (k : ℤ), KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖)
arguments.proof:
intro f g k hf hg
have hfs : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖f j‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight] using hf
have hgs : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖g j‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight] using hg
have hgs' : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖g (k-j)‖^2) := by
  simpa only [Equiv.subLeft_apply] using (Equiv.subLeft k).summable_iff.mpr hgs
apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) _ ((hfs.add hgs').div_const 2)
intro j
nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖f j‖-‖g (k-j)‖)]

helper.statement: ∀ (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff) (k : ℤ), KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖)

arguments.statement: (∀ (t : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.J t 0 f = 0 ∧ KdVPlan.J t f 0 = 0) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH s (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f))
arguments.proof:
constructor
· intro t f
  constructor <;> funext k <;> simp [KdVPlan.J, KdVPlan.S, KdVPlan.invD, KdVPlan.P, KdVPlan.mul]
· intro n s f
  apply summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.Icc (-(n : ℤ)) (n : ℤ))
  intro k hk
  have hb : ¬ |(k : ℝ)| ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    intro h
    have hr := abs_le.mp h
    have h1 : -(n : ℤ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hr.1
    have h2 : k ≤ (n : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hr.2
    exact hk (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h1,h2⟩)
  simp [KdVPlan.cutoff, hb]

arguments.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.MemH 2 f → KdVPlan.MemH 2 g → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean g → (∀ k : ℤ, IntervalIntegrable (fun t => KdVPlan.B t f g k) MeasureTheory.volume a b) ∧ KdVPlan.stage a b f g = KdVPlan.scale (1/6) (KdVPlan.J b f g-KdVPlan.J a f g)
arguments.proof:
intro a b f g hab hf hg hzf hzg
let C := KdVPlan.hn 2 f+KdVPlan.hn 2 g
have hC : 0 ≤ C := add_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
have hfbd : ∀ j : ℤ, ‖f j‖ ≤ C/(1+(j : ℝ)^2) := by
  intro j
  exact ((yui_aux_0004 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f j).2 hf).trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑' k, KdVPlan.weight 2 k*‖g k‖^2)]) (by positivity))
have hgbd : ∀ j : ℤ, ‖g j‖ ≤ C/(1+(j : ℝ)^2) := by
  intro j
  exact ((yui_aux_0004 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 g j).2 hg).trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (∑' k, KdVPlan.weight 2 k*‖f k‖^2)]) (by positivity))
have H := yui_aux_0019 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b (fun _ => f) (fun _ => g) C C hC hC (fun _ => continuousOn_const) (fun _ => continuousOn_const) (fun _ _ => hfbd) (fun _ _ j => (hgbd j).trans (div_le_self hC (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (j : ℝ)])))
have hd := yui_aux_0020 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b (fun _ => f) (fun _ => g) 0 0 C hC (by
  intro u hu t ht j
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hu
  rcases hu with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact hfbd j
  · exact hgbd j
  · exact div_nonneg hC (by positivity)
  · exact div_nonneg hC (by positivity)) (fun t ht j => ⟨hasDerivAt_const t _, hasDerivAt_const t _⟩) (fun _ _ => ⟨hzf,hzg⟩)
have hi : ∀ k : ℤ, IntervalIntegrable (fun t => KdVPlan.B t f g k) MeasureTheory.volume a b := fun k => (H k).1.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hab
refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
funext k
have hder : ∀ t ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt (fun r => KdVPlan.J r f g k) (3*KdVPlan.B t f g k) t := by
  intro t ht
  simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013).1 t g |>.1, (yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013).1 t f |>.2, add_zero] using hd t ht k
have he := intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt_of_le hab (H k).2.1 hder ((hi k).const_mul 3)
rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul] at he
change (1/2 : ℂ)*(∫ t in a..b, KdVPlan.B t f g k) = (1/6 : ℂ)*(KdVPlan.J b f g k-KdVPlan.J a f g k)
linear_combination (1/6 : ℂ)*he

arguments.statement: ∀ f : KdVPlan.Coeff, (∀ (N : ℝ) (j : ℤ), ‖KdVPlan.cutoff N f j‖ ≤ ‖f j‖) ∧ (∀ (j : ℤ), ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f j = f j) ∧ (KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → ∀ N : ℝ, KdVPlan.ZeroMean (KdVPlan.cutoff N f))
arguments.proof:
intro f
refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro N j
  unfold KdVPlan.cutoff
  split_ifs <;> simp
· intro j
  filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop j.natAbs] with n hn
  apply if_pos
  have hr : |(j : ℝ)| = (j.natAbs : ℝ) := by norm_cast; exact Int.natCast_natAbs j |>.symm
  rw [hr]
  exact_mod_cast hn
· intro hf N
  change (if |((0 : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ N then f 0 else 0) = 0
  rw [hf]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

intro f

  exact_mod_cast hn

  rw [hf]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

11: /-!
12: # Tannery's theorem
13: 
14: Tannery's theorem gives a sufficient criterion for the limit of an infinite sum (with respect to
15: an auxiliary parameter) to equal the sum of the pointwise limits. See
16: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tannery%27s_theorem. It is a special case of the dominated convergence
17: theorem (with the measure chosen to be the counting measure); but we give here a direct proof, in
18: order to avoid some unnecessary hypotheses that appear when specialising the general
19: measure-theoretic result.
20: -/
21: 
22: public section
23: 
24: open Filter Topology
25: 
26: set_option linter.style.whitespace false in -- manual alignment is not recognised
27: /-- **Tannery's theorem**: topological sums commute with termwise limits, when the norms of the
28: summands are eventually uniformly bounded by a summable function.
29: 
30: (This is the special case of the Lebesgue dominated convergence theorem for the counting measure
31: on a discrete set. However, we prove it under somewhat weaker assumptions than the general
32: measure-theoretic result, e.g. `G` is not assumed to be an `ℝ`-vector space or second countable,
33: and the limit is along an arbitrary filter rather than `atTop ℕ`.)
34: 
35: See also:
36: * `MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence` (for general integrals, but
37:   with more assumptions on `G`)
38: * `continuous_tsum` (continuity of infinite sums in a parameter)
39: -/
40: lemma tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence {α β G : Type*} {𝓕 : Filter α}
41:     [NormedAddCommGroup G] [CompleteSpace G]
42:     {f : α → β → G} {g : β → G} {bound : β → ℝ} (h_sum : Summable bound)
43:     (hab : ∀ k : β, Tendsto (f · k) 𝓕 (𝓝 (g k)))
44:     (h_bound : ∀ᶠ n in 𝓕, ∀ k, ‖f n k‖ ≤ bound k) :
45:     Tendsto (∑' k, f · k) 𝓕 (𝓝 (∑' k, g k)) := by
46:   -- WLOG β is nonempty
47:   rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty β
48:   · simpa only [tsum_empty] using tendsto_const_nhds
49:   -- WLOG 𝓕 ≠ ⊥
50:   rcases 𝓕.eq_or_neBot with rfl | _
51:   · simp only [tendsto_bot]
52:   -- Auxiliary lemmas
53:   have h_g_le (k : β) : ‖g k‖ ≤ bound k :=
54:     le_of_tendsto (tendsto_norm.comp (hab k)) <| h_bound.mono (fun n h => h k)
55:   have h_sumg : Summable (‖g ·‖) :=
56:     h_sum.of_norm_bounded (fun k ↦ (norm_norm (g k)).symm ▸ h_g_le k)
57:   have h_suma : ∀ᶠ n in 𝓕, Summable (‖f n ·‖) := by
58:     filter_upwards [h_bound] with n h
59:     exact h_sum.of_norm_bounded <| by simpa only [norm_norm] using h
60:   -- Now main proof, by an `ε / 3` argument
61:   rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds]
62:   intro ε hε
63:   let ⟨S, hS⟩ := h_sum
64:   obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ : ∃ (T : Finset β), dist (∑ b ∈ T, bound b) S < ε / 3 := by
65:     rw [HasSum, Metric.tendsto_nhds] at hS
66:     classical exact Eventually.exists <| hS _ (by positivity)
67:   have h1 : ∑' (k : (Tᶜ : Set β)), bound k < ε / 3 := by
68:     calc _ ≤ ‖∑' (k : (Tᶜ : Set β)), bound k‖ := Real.le_norm_self _
69:          _ = ‖S - ∑ b ∈ T, bound b‖           := congrArg _ ?_
70:          _ < ε / 3                            := by rwa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] at hT
71:     simpa only [h_sum.sum_add_tsum_compl, eq_sub_iff_add_eq'] using hS.tsum_eq
72:   have h2 : Tendsto (∑ k ∈ T, f · k) 𝓕 (𝓝 (T.sum g)) := tendsto_finsetSum _ (fun i _ ↦ hab i)
73:   rw [Metric.tendsto_nhds] at h2
74:   filter_upwards [h2 (ε / 3) (by positivity), h_suma, h_bound] with n hn h_suma h_bound
75:   rw [dist_eq_norm, ← h_suma.of_norm.tsum_sub h_sumg.of_norm,
76:     ← (h_suma.of_norm.sub h_sumg.of_norm).sum_add_tsum_compl (s := T),
77:     (by ring : ε = ε / 3 + (ε / 3 + ε / 3))]
78:   refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans_lt (add_lt_add ?_ ?_)
79:   · simpa only [dist_eq_norm, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] using hn
80:   · rw [(h_suma.subtype _).of_norm.tsum_sub (h_sumg.subtype _).of_norm]
81:     refine (norm_sub_le _ _).trans_lt (add_lt_add ?_ ?_)
82:     · refine ((norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (h_suma.subtype _)).trans ?_).trans_lt h1
83:       exact (h_suma.subtype _).tsum_le_tsum (h_bound ·) (h_sum.subtype _)
84:     · refine ((norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm <| h_sumg.subtype _).trans ?_).trans_lt h1
85:       exact (h_sumg.subtype _).tsum_le_tsum (h_g_le ·) (h_sum.subtype _)

159: ## The Lebesgue dominated convergence theorem for interval integrals
160: As an application, we show continuity of parametric integrals.
161: -/
162: namespace intervalIntegral
163: 
164: section DCT
165: 
166: variable {ι E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
167:   {a b : ℝ} {f : ℝ → E} {μ : Measure ℝ}

170: nonrec theorem tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence {ι} {l : Filter ι}
171:     [l.IsCountablyGenerated] {F : ι → ℝ → E} (bound : ℝ → ℝ)
172:     (hF_meas : ∀ᶠ n in l, AEStronglyMeasurable (F n) (μ.restrict (Ι a b)))
173:     (h_bound : ∀ᶠ n in l, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Ι a b → ‖F n x‖ ≤ bound x)
174:     (bound_integrable : IntervalIntegrable bound μ a b)
175:     (h_lim : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ Ι a b → Tendsto (fun n => F n x) l (𝓝 (f x))) :
176:     Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x in a..b, F n x ∂μ) l (𝓝 <| ∫ x in a..b, f x ∂μ) := by
177:   simp only [intervalIntegrable_iff, intervalIntegral_eq_integral_uIoc,
178:     ← ae_restrict_iff' (α := ℝ) (μ := μ) measurableSet_uIoc] at *
179:   exact tendsto_const_nhds.smul <|
180:     tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence bound hF_meas h_bound bound_integrable h_lim
181: 
182: theorem _root_.TendstoUniformlyOn.tendsto_intervalIntegral_of_continuousOn
183:     {l : Filter ι} [l.IsCountablyGenerated] {F : ι → ℝ → E}
184:     [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] (hF : ∀ᶠ i in l, ContinuousOn (F i) [[a, b]])

187:   rcases l.eq_or_neBot with rfl | hl
188:   · simp

arguments.statement: ∀ (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff) (k : ℤ) (W : ℤ → ℂ) (M : ℝ), KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → 0 ≤ M → (∀ j : ℤ, ‖W j‖ ≤ M) → (∀ n : ℕ, ‖∑' j : ℤ, W j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g (k-j)‖ ≤ M*(∑' j : ℤ, ‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑' j : ℤ, W j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g (k-j)) Filter.atTop (nhds (∑' j : ℤ, W j * f j * g (k-j)))
arguments.proof:
intro f g k W M hf hg hM hW
have hs := (yui_aux_0029 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f g k hf hg).mul_left M
have hb : ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : ℤ), ‖W j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g (k-j)‖ ≤ M*(‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖) := by
  intro n j
  simp only [norm_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ M*‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖ := mul_le_mul
      (mul_le_mul (hW j) ((yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f).1 _ j) (norm_nonneg _) hM)
      ((yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 g).1 _ (k-j)) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring
constructor
· intro n
  have hnorm : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖W j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g (k-j)‖) := hs.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => norm_nonneg _) (hb n)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑' j : ℤ, ‖W j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f j * KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g (k-j)‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm hnorm
    _ ≤ ∑' j : ℤ, M*(‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖) := hnorm.tsum_le_tsum (hb n) hs
    _ = _ := tsum_mul_left
· apply tendsto_tsum_of_dominated_convergence hs
  · intro j
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [(yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f).2.1 j, (yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 g).2.1 (k-j)] with n hfn hgn
    rw [hfn, hgn]
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb

70: intervals is always empty, so this property is equivalent to `f` being integrable on

72: def IntervalIntegrable (f : ℝ → ε) (μ : Measure ℝ) (a b : ℝ) : Prop :=

75: /-!
76: ## Basic iff's for `IntervalIntegrable`
77: -/
78: section
79: 
80: variable [PseudoMetrizableSpace ε] {f : ℝ → ε} {a b : ℝ} {μ : Measure ℝ}
81: 
82: /-- A function is interval integrable with respect to a given measure `μ` on `a..b` if and
83:   only if it is integrable on `uIoc a b` with respect to `μ`. This is an equivalent
84:   definition of `IntervalIntegrable`. -/
85: theorem intervalIntegrable_iff : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b ↔ IntegrableOn f (Ι a b) μ := by
86:   rw [uIoc_eq_union, integrableOn_union, IntervalIntegrable]
87: 
88: /-- If a function is interval integrable with respect to a given measure `μ` on `a..b` then
89:   it is integrable on `uIoc a b` with respect to `μ`. -/
90: theorem IntervalIntegrable.def' (h : IntervalIntegrable f μ a b) : IntegrableOn f (Ι a b) μ :=
91:   intervalIntegrable_iff.mp h
92: 
93: theorem intervalIntegrable_congr_ae {g : ℝ → ε} (h : f =ᵐ[μ.restrict (Ι a b)] g) :
94:     IntervalIntegrable f μ a b ↔ IntervalIntegrable g μ a b := by

arguments.statement: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (f g : KdVPlan.Coeff), a ≤ b → KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean g → KdVPlan.stage a b f g = KdVPlan.scale (1/6) (KdVPlan.J b f g-KdVPlan.J a f g)
arguments.proof:
intro a b f g hab hf hg hzf hzg
have hc (n : ℕ) := yui_aux_0031 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 a b (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) hab
  ((yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013).2 n 2 f) ((yui_aux_0030 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013).2 n 2 g)
  ((yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f).2.2 hzf _) ((yui_aux_0032 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 g).2.2 hzg _)
funext k
have H := yui_aux_0034 T gamma R h_T016 h_T013 f g k hf hg
have hlim := intervalIntegral.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
  (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) (a := a) (b := b)
  (F := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) k)
  (f := fun t => KdVPlan.B t f g k)
  (fun _ => |(k : ℝ)| * (∑' j : ℤ, ‖f j‖*‖g (k-j)‖))
  (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => ((hc n).1 k).def'.aestronglyMeasurable))
  (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t _ => H.1 n t)))
  intervalIntegrable_const
  (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t _ => H.2.1 t))
have hl := hlim.const_mul (1/2 : ℂ)
have hr := ((H.2.2 b).sub (H.2.2 a)).const_mul (1/6 : ℂ)
have heq : (fun n : ℕ => (1/2 : ℂ)*(∫ t in a..b, KdVPlan.B t (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) k)) =
  (fun n : ℕ => (1/6 : ℂ)*(KdVPlan.J b (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) k-KdVPlan.J a (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) f) (KdVPlan.cutoff (n : ℝ) g) k)) := by
  funext n
  exact congrFun (hc n).2 k
rw [← heq] at hr
exact tendsto_nhds_unique hl hr
